item.title: Your list of cannot-miss Place events
item.description: Networking, best practice learning, and market intel gathering: Place’s calendar of events brings the property industry together for more than just one week at MIPIM. The post Your list of cannot-miss Place events appeared first on Place North West.

item.title: The Ivy grows Chester plans
item.description: Over the course of three separate applications, Troia Restaurants has outlined its proposals to take over the former All Bar One venue and launch its third North West destination. The post The Ivy grows Chester plans appeared first on Place North West.

item.title: Manchester looks to finish Water Street regen zone with quartet of towers
item.description: With Potato Wharf complete and Trinity Islands progressing, the city council is increasing its ambitions for the redevelopment of the 4.4-acre Manchester Industrial Centre, which sits between the two. The post Manchester looks to finish Water Street regen zone with quartet of towers appeared first on Place North West.

item.title: Woodford Garden Village £25m retirement community completes
item.description: Vistry has finished building 87 apartments and 17 bungalows for Anchor on four acres of the former airfield and aircraft factory in Stockport. The post Woodford Garden Village £25m retirement community completes appeared first on Place North West.

item.title: Why investors should look to North East England in 2026
item.description: North East England is a region built on invention, industry and opportunity, writes Michelle Duggan of North East Combined Authority. The post Why investors should look to North East England in 2026 appeared first on Place North West.

item.title: Chester’s temporary car park leisure hub to stay
item.description: Grosvenor is bidding to make the conversion of the top two floors of the Pepper Street multi-storey car park in the city centre permanent following the venue’s “commercial success” over the last 15 months. The post Chester’s temporary car park leisure hub to stay appeared first on Place North West.

item.title: Tilbury Douglas completes GMIoT in Salford
item.description: Located at the Peel Park campus, the 20,000 sq ft Greater Manchester Institute of Technology building will be used as a central hub by colleges working with the university. The post Tilbury Douglas completes GMIoT in Salford appeared first on Place North West.

item.title: Man City to bring Mamma Mia! The Party to Etihad
item.description: Forming part of the club’s £300m Medlock Square leisure quarter, the immersive, theatrical dining experience will be housed in a three-storey venue next to the stadium. The post Man City to bring Mamma Mia! The Party to Etihad appeared first on Place North West.

item.title: Manchester secures backing for affording housing pipeline through GMPF deal
item.description: After nine months of gestation, the Manchester City Council and Greater Manchester Pension Fund partnership with ambitions to deliver nearly 1,600 homes is ready to be born. The post Manchester secures backing for affording housing pipeline through GMPF deal appeared first on Place North West.
